INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.

3. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation.

6. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills.

7. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry.

8. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

9. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.

10. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry.

11. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Only memorise without using the language

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 7.2.1 Reading for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling - Legends and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 9.2.1 Extensive reading – Grade- appropriate texts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
